We need answer JSON only. Need evaluate each story against Minimal criterion. Need understand criterion: "A user story contains nothing more than role, means, and optional ends/rationale. Violation when the core story includes comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, or other information that should be external to the story sentence."

We need assess each PP-001 to PP-053. Need return exactly 53 evaluations. We can inspect each story. Need decide yes/no.

Minimal is syntactic individual. User stories typically "As a <role>, I want <means>, so that <ends>". Anything extra beyond role, means, optional rationale = violation. Examples: PP-027 contains set notation {0,1/2...} and "etc." maybe implementation detail? This is extra info? It specifies options in means. Is that implementation detail? Could be arguably necessary to express means. Minimal says nothing more than role, means, optional ends. The means is "select whether to have the team estimate with {..} or {..}" that is role, means, rationale. The braces etc. are not comments/mockup? It's part of means, maybe more detail but not external? Need decide.

We need judge only Minimal. Let's list stories and potential violations.

Definitions:
- Core story includes comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, or other info external to story sentence.

Some stories include redundant phrases like PP-006 "so that so that" duplicate, still role means rationale. Not violation? It's not extra beyond role/means/rationale; typo. Minimal? Could be no violation since still contains nothing more. But "so that so that" maybe syntax error not minimal. Not penalize? criterion is extra information. No.

PP-004: As a moderator, I want to see all items we try to estimate this session, so that I can answer questions about the current story such as "does this include ___". Here means includes examples? The rationale has an example quotation. Is that extra? It is rationale? "so that I can answer questions about the current story such as ..." This is rationale but includes illustrative example. Minimal maybe violation because includes example note "does this include ___" beyond core. Need think.

PP-009: "show all estimates immediately, so that I can decide to show the estimates that have been given even though not all estimators have given their estimate." Means and rationale. No extra.

PP-011: "have the 'estimate' field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card" That includes implementation detail "field"? Might be UI implementation hint. "estimate" field. But the means itself can be described as field. Minimal violation? Possibly not, since user story can mention a field. But criterion strictly says implementation hints external. However "field filled in automatically" is requirement, not external hint. No violation.

PP-027: "select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}" This includes enumerated card sets. Is that extra? It is part of means specifying options. But maybe stories shouldn't include exact details? Yet minimal says role, means, optional ends. It does exactly that, but the means has a list. I think no violation.

PP-028: "invite up to 15 estimators, so that we can play with large but not immense teams." Limit 15 is means. No.

PP-035: "see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated, so that I can see how his or her opinion has changed so I can ask questions." Means rationale. no.

PP-037: "be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see" missing "to" before start. Still role means rationale. no extra.

PP-042: "have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played, so that the game is more personal because I see who I'm estimating with." Means rationale. no extra.

PP-043: "As a developer, I want to have written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards, so that as many people as possible can access the site and view it as intended." Means includes "have written a site which is compliant..." Might be implementation/testing hint? It says what developer wants, but "XHTML and CSS standards" could be technical requirement but not extra beyond means. Minimal no violation? It contains role, means, rationale.

PP-044: "As a developer, I want to have a list of definitions for commonly used terms, so that everyone working on the project can understand each other more easily." means rationale. no.

PP-045: "As a developer, I want to have created database indexes, so that the queries run as fast as possible." Means is implementation detail "database indexes" but still the desired functionality? Need decide. This story is not user-facing, but minimal syntax? Contains role, means, rationale. No comments. So no violation? Hmm.

The QUS Minimal likely penalizes extra info like "I want a service that does X (note: use Redis)" or "the UI must have a dropdown". We need identify any actual extra phrases.

Role: moderator. Means: create a new game by entering a name and optional description. Ends: so that I can start inviting estimators. No extra. No violation.

Minimal says "optional ends/rationale" not examples. However the example is part of rationale? Could be not.
